 NOTRE DAME, Ind. (WSBT) — South Bend is the center of the college football world this weekend as No. 11 Notre Dame prepares to host top-ranked Miami.
 ESPN’s College GameDay is back on campus for the first time since Notre Dame hosted Indiana in the opening round of the 2024 College Football Playoff.
 WSBT 22 Sports spoke with host Rece Davis and analyst Josh Pate. They shared their thoughts on the top-15 matchup and said they enjoy the tradition and atmosphere that come with broadcasting from Notre Dame.
 The GameDay set joins other football events on campus, including appearances by Pat McAfee and Barstool Sports.
 College GameDay will broadcast live from Library Lawn, on the north side of Notre Dame Stadium. 
 The show begins at 9 a.m. on Saturday.
